import pathlib,json,datetime
p=pathlib.Path("/home/appontrack/.ontrack-mobile")
out={"checked_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
f=p/"device-seen.json"
if f.is_file():
 d=json.loads(f.read_text());seen=d.get("seen_at");out["last_device_heartbeat_utc"]=seen
 try:out["heartbeat_age_seconds"]=round((datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)-datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(seen.replace("Z","+00:00"))).total_seconds())
 except (ValueError,TypeError):pass
else:out["last_device_heartbeat_utc"]=None
settings=p/"settings.json"
if settings.is_file():
 s=json.loads(settings.read_text());out["settings_enabled"]=s.get("enabled");out["auto_answer_enabled"]=s.get("auto_answer");out["settings_revision"]=s.get("revision")
else:out["settings_available"]=False
print(json.dumps(out))
